ashby:antithesis:12cee240-67dc-489d-87b4.summary:
Antithesis helps engineering teams find and fix bugs that traditional testing misses.

Our platform runs entire systems in a deterministic simulation, breaks them in every imaginable way, and provides engineers with root cause analysis and perfect reproduction. The result is faster debugging, more reliable software, and more confidence in what ships.

As AI accelerates software development, the need for reliable verification is only increasing. Antithesis exists to solve that problem.

We are well-funded, deeply technical, and building a category-defining platform for modern software reliability.

ashby:aphex:2c2a39f2-72fa-41ad-820e-4e15.summary:
At Aphex ( https://www.aphex.co/ ), we believe the best way to improve construction delivery is to give people the tools and time to do their jobs. That's why we're on a mission to transform how engineers and superintendents and site managers plan, communicate, and track their work every day.

Our customers are the industry's giants - building the tunnels, roads, bridges, and power plants that define our cities. Our users are the engineers and project managers who make these projects happen. Since launching in the UK in 2019, we've become the dominant platform for infrastructure and major construction projects across the UK, Australia, and New Zealand, with most of these countries' major infrastructure projects now running on Aphex.

sections.title: About Aphex
paras: We're now expanding into North America - this is a founding role, joining some of the team relocating from our London office to launch the new office. We've already got clients on major infrastructure projects around Toronto, and strong product-market fit proven in three other markets. Construction contributes around 10% of global GDP yet has barely moved the needle on productivity in decades. We're changing that, and the market is responding.

This is a genuinely exciting time to join: you'll be one of the first hires on the ground in North America, with real scope to shape how the office and playbook develop as we scale, and clear progression as the team grows.

sections.title: The Role
paras: You've spent years on construction sites. You know what it's like when the Monday planning meeting falls apart, when the subcontractor schedule is three weeks out of date, and when nobody can tell you what's actually happening next week. You've lived that frustration. We need someone who's been on the other side of the hoarding to help our biggest accounts get the most out of Aphex and grow with us as we scale internationally.

At Aphex, we believe deeply that we are in the business of successful construction project delivery. As an Account Manager, you'll embody this principle, focusing first on helping projects succeed, which naturally leads to enterprise growth and expansion opportunities.

You'll join a high-performing go-to-market team of sales and customer success professionals, stepping into a pivotal Account Manager role. You will be one of the founding members of our North America team, working alongside some of the core members of our UK team who are relocating to Toronto to help launch our presence there. We've crafted and refined our playbooks in the UK to ensure you can transition smoothly, with the support and structure needed to excel. It's perfect for someone with a deep understanding of construction, eager to leverage their experience in a fast-moving and rewarding environment - and to help build something from the ground up.

sections.title: What You'll Actually Do
paras: Your core job is to make projects succeed on Aphex. When projects succeed, the account grows - new divisions, new seats, new products. You own that cycle for your accounts.
bullets: Drive adoption on live projects - not from a distance, but by understanding how each team plans and helping them do it better with Aphex
Build relationships with senior stakeholders — Heads of Planning, Operations Directors, Digital Leads - the people who decide whether Aphex becomes the standard
Spot and create expansion opportunities - new divisions, new project types, new products like Aphex Diary
Work with and lead customer success managers to deliver great onboarding and activation for customers
Help customers build consistent operating processes across their projects so Aphex becomes how they work, not another tool to manage
Hit your numbers - quarterly and annual expansion targets, and you'll be expected to deliver
Help shape the North America playbook as one of the first people on the ground

sections.title: Who This Is For
bullets: You've been on site for 5+ years - as a Superintendent, Site Supervisor, or Project Manager. You know how construction projects actually run, not how textbooks say they should.
You're ready for a change - not because you've failed in construction, but because you want to use everything you've learned differently. You want to work with technology, not against it.
You can hold a room. You're comfortable presenting to a Site Manager, a Head of Planning, or an Operations Director - because you've worked alongside people like them your whole career.
You take ownership. When something's yours, it's yours. You don't wait to be told what to do next.
You're excited by the idea of building a new market and office from the early days, not just joining an established team.

sections.title: What you will own

Set the product direction for APIs, integrations, workspaces, permissions, governance, audit, and reliability in close partnership with customers, Design, and Engineering.
Make hard product choices and separate reusable capability from one-off requests while staying responsive to urgent customer and business needs.
Turn company and product strategy into clear outcomes, priorities, owners, and metrics through planning, reviews, demos, and decision follow-through.
Establish a productive cadence across Product, Design, and Engineering that improves how teams define problems, make tradeoffs, launch, measure results, and learn.

Agentic Product builds agent-powered products that move customer work forward: agent behavior, hypotheses, evidence, recommendations, and the human feedback and approval loop.
Core Product owns the everyday customer experience: the issue view and lifecycle, investigation and resolution, monitoring and alerts, dashboards, and Studio.

bullets: You deliver meaningful customer and business results in your own product charter.
Product, Design, and Engineering operate through a shared cadence that produces clearer decisions and stronger follow-through.
Product reviews and demos improve product quality, learning, and company alignment rather than becoming status meetings.
The PM team demonstrates stronger judgment and ownership, and Enterprise Platform has a clearer direction across integrations, controls, governance, and shared foundations.
The product team executes with less routine dependence on the executive above it

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Most agents are judged on benchmarks. Ours are judged on whether a 40-ton machine works better next week.

Bedrock is building a company that scales with data, compute and agents, so that each new capability, machine and decision costs less and lands faster than the last. Agents already do real work here, at scale: they triage field issues, assemble release evidence, draft plans and write most of our code. And we're already seeing how autonomous research can unlock new capabilities by leveraging the right data, evaluation and sim.
You'll own the product for this, end to end:
bullets: The agent platform. Where agents at Bedrock run, get evaluated, earn trust for load-bearing work, and get measured.
Robotics auto-research. Agent loops that improve our autonomy stack, our data, our simulation and our infrastructure, faster than a team of people could on its own.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Set the strategy and roadmap for agents and auto-research at Bedrock. Decide which loops to build next based on how much they move capability, cost and speed.
Define what it takes for an agent to be load-bearing: the evals, reliability bar, human oversight and feedback loop a team needs before it relies on one.
Turn auto-research from a few promising loops into a production system, with budgets, verdicts, provenance and a clear line from experiment to a capability that ships.
Own the metrics that show whether this works, such as agent adoption, the share of capability work done by auto-research, and cost and time per result. Get them measured, then get them goaled.
Make our internal systems agent-ready so agents can read, act and be held accountable across data, simulation, code, planning and decisions.
Keep us model-agnostic as the frontier moves: the best model for each workload, while context, traces and memory stay ours.
Build. Prototype agents, evals and workflows yourself with AI coding tools instead of writing specs about them.
Help drive adoption across engineering, operations and commercial teams, and be the person who knows when an agent should not be trusted.

sections.title: Required
bullets: 5+ years in product, research or engineering roles, including shipping LLM agents or AI systems that people rely on in production.
Hands-on depth in how frontier models and agents behave: harnesses, tool use, context, evals, cost and failure modes. You form your own view of a new model within days of its release.
Experience designing evaluations for open-ended model behavior and making product calls from them.
AI-native in your own work. You use Claude Code, Codex or similar every day, read code fluently and ship prototypes.
Comfort with ML experimentation and research workflows: you can follow a research discussion with engineers and push on its rigor.
Clear, concise writing. You turn an ambiguous direction into a plan with measurable outcomes that a team can act on.
A track record of agency: you've taken a problem nobody owned and carried it to a real result.

sections.title: Preferred
bullets: Experience at a frontier AI lab or AI-native startup working on agents, evals, RL environments or automated research.
Background in robotics, autonomy, simulation or ML infrastructure.
Built an internal developer or research platform adopted across many teams.
Published research or open-source work on agents, evals or AI for science.

ashby:cardless:51dd66d4-3590-4e50-a611-9.summary:
Cardless is building the infrastructure for the world's best companies to design, build, and launch financial products. Companies like Coinbase and Bilt use Cardless to create credit cards that feel entirely their own. In an industry where branded financial products usually mean shared logos and shared control, Cardless is built to disappear. Our APIs and components shape the journey from the first application to every purchase, reward, and moment of support that follows, while we handle lending, compliance, and operations behind the scenes.

In September 2025, we raised a $60 million Series C led by Spark Capital, bringing our total funding to $170 million. The team is over 70 people and scaling toward profitability by year-end 2026.

sections.title: About Cardless
paras: We're looking for kind, humble people with high standards and low egos. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We see what could be improved, make it so, and leave every product, system, and team better than we found it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Cardless operates at the intersection of financial infrastructure, brand partnerships, and capital markets — and the distance between what the market thinks of Cardless and what we actually do is where growth either accelerates or stalls. This role exists to close that gap.

Cardless is hiring its first product marketing hire — a senior, hands-on PMM who will define how we talk about ourselves in the market and build the narrative our business team uses to land our newest customers. This is a hybrid role by design: you'll own brand narrative and positioning (including our website), have the freedom to start investing in blogging, social channels, and other forms of thought leadership, and you'll own our sales collateral (decks, one-pagers, case studies, battlecards). Those two things should come from the same person and the same story, especially at this stage.

We're a B2B2C business: we sell to enterprise partners (brands, banks, or programs), and those partners in turn put a card in front of their own consumers. You'll need to be comfortable positioning for both audiences — the enterprise buyer evaluating a platform, and the eventual cardholder experience that buyer is signing up for.

sections.title: Define Market Positioning
bullets: Define and continually sharpen how Cardless is positioned against competitors and alternatives (in-house programs, legacy processors, other co-brand platforms) — not a static one-pager, but a narrative you keep pressure-testing against the market.
Translate that positioning into language that works for two audiences at once: the enterprise partner evaluating a platform, and the consumer who eventually carries the card.
Track competitors and adjacent players — what they claim, what they actually ship, and where Cardless has a genuine edge — and keep leadership current on it.
Bring an outside-in view into internal roadmap conversations, grounded in what's actually resonating — or not — with partners and prospects.

sections.title: Own the Website and Brand Narrative
bullets: Own content strategy, structure, and copy for cardless.com , keeping it current with new launches, partnerships, and proof points.
Direct design and engineering resources to execute changes — you set the narrative and the bar, you don't need to build the page yourself.
Make sure every public-facing surface — website, decks, one-pagers — tells the same consistent story, instead of three different versions of what Cardless does.
Treat the website as a living asset, not a one-time project — revisit and rewrite it as the product and market change, not once a year.

bullets: Run technical sales cycles end to end. Own discovery, solution design, demos, POV execution, and technical close for opportunities within strategic US enterprises. Partner with Account Executives on commercial strategy; drive the technical win independently.

You'll help them understand how to observe, trust, and improve those systems — from the data pipelines feeding agents, to the context they retrieve, the decisions they make, and the outputs they produce.
Drive POVs that convert. Design proofs of value with agreed success criteria, manage the evaluation, and deliver results that remove technical objections and accelerate the commercial close.

Build technical champions. Identify and develop the advocates inside each account who will carry Monte Carlo into the next budget cycle, platform decision, or executive review. Run briefings, workshops, and architecture reviews that position our platform as infrastructure.

Bring a technical point of view. Understand each customer's data and AI architecture deeply — where agents run, how they're instrumented, and where reliability breaks down. Bring that perspective to every account plan and QBR.

sections.title: What We're Looking For
bullets: Hands-on experience with enterprise AI and agent deployments. You've deployed agents in enterprise organizations — or worked closely enough with teams that do to understand the architecture, the failure modes, and the operational reality. You know what it takes to get an agent from demo to production.

Fluency in AI observability concepts. Traces, spans, evaluations, instrumentation — these are working vocabulary, not buzzwords. Experience with OpenTelemetry is highly prized, as is exposure to Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex, or similar enterprise AI platforms.

3+ years in pre-sales, solutions engineering, or strategic technical account management within B2B AI-first companies and SaaS organizations, with meaningful experience in enterprise accounts. You've navigated procurement, infosec reviews, and multi-stakeholder buying committees.
Domain background in data, observability, agent trust, or agent-first products. You've worked in one of these, not next to one.

Equal parts technical and business focused. You can whiteboard an agent architecture and hold a conversation with a VP of Data & AI about ROI and competitive positioning. Credible with engineers, effective with executives.
Self-directed and accountable. A lean team with high-value accounts. You prioritize your own time, know when to escalate, and know when to push back.
Strong communicator across seniority levels. Equally comfortable in a technical deep-dive with a platform engineer and presenting a business case to a C-minus-1.

sections.title: Preferred, Not Required
bullets: Modern data stack experience: Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Airflow, BigQuery, or similar. Data observability or data quality experience is a plus.
Experience growing existing enterprise accounts — expansion, upsell, or land-and-expand motions.
Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar sales qualification and value frameworks.
Experience selling into enterprises across multiple countries and regulatory environments.
Hands-on prototyping during a sales cycle.

ashby:morpho:076703f0-d899-43bb-8db9-4c0.summary: Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

sections.title: Why Morpho Exists
paras: Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here .

sections.title: Location
paras: New York preferred. Remote is possible between GMT-5 and GMT+2.

sections.title: Role
paras: Banks, asset managers and token issuers are bringing stocks, funds and other real-world assets onchain. Those assets become far more useful once their holders can borrow against them and lend them out. Midnight, Morpho's fixed-rate, fixed-term lending protocol, gives institutions the predictable terms they need to do that.

This role owns the products that make Morpho the credit layer for institutional assets, spanning tokenized equities and funds as collateral, loans backed by assets held with a qualified custodian, and the onchain equivalents of repo and securities lending.

Close partnership with institutions is central to this role. You will develop a detailed understanding of how they operate across trading, custody and compliance, and translate their requirements into products that scale across many partners.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for institutional credit on Morpho, end to end.

Act as Morpho's domain expert on the institutional market. Go deep with issuers, asset managers, banks, custodians and brokers on how they finance and lend assets, represent Morpho with them, and turn conflicting input into precise problem statements and requirements.
Decide which issuers and asset types come first, which wait and which Morpho declines, and make the trade-offs explicit.
Judge which partner-specific requests become standard capabilities many institutions can use, and make the build or partner call for each.
Work as a peer to the protocol team on design trade-offs, bringing legal and risk in early on custody, transfer restrictions, valuation and liquidation for each asset type.
Drive each initiative from problem definition through launch and adoption, across teams you do not manage. Define success before launch, measured in active loans.

ashby:noto:5b331f2d-d3bc-43ca-a4f1-77ba4.summary:
Noto is the AI-native operating system for after-school businesses: tutoring centers, music schools, sports academies, and dance studios. About 360,000 of these businesses operate in the U.S., and millions of kids pass through them every week.

They’re run by people who are passionate about teaching but spend their evenings managing schedules, payroll, and parent emails, often in software built in 2011, or in spreadsheets and sticky notes.

Noto replaces the entire stack with a modern platform for scheduling, billing, payroll, marketing, CRM, communications, classroom management, and student and parent portals. We bring the whole back office into one place, with AI agents that automate manual work instead of simply tracking it.

sections.title: About Noto
paras: A school that spends less time on paperwork can teach more kids, hire another teacher, and grow its business. Come help us build the best operating system for these small-business owners!

sections.title: Team
paras: We’re a team of 20 in New York City. We value working with other smart, collaborative, ambitious, and kind people.

AJ Ding (CEO) — second-time founder who previously built an AI recruiting company. ML engineer and data scientist at Quora, Lyft, and Meta. Studied statistics at Yale and grew up in a family of small-business owners.
Steve Wang (CTO) — former Head of Engineering at Nitra, an a16z-backed vertical SaaS company for doctors. Previously worked in data science and engineering at Lyft. Studied math at Harvard.

sections.title: The CS Team
paras: Today, five Customer Success Managers each own their customers end to end. They run kickoff, migrate data, configure the account, train staff, take go-live calls, answer support tickets and manage the account after launch. That model got us to 400+ customers, but it won't get us to 10,000. You will be the first leader of the entire post-sales process, and own this function end to end.

sections.title: The role
paras: As the Head of Customer Success, you'll design and build the team, and turn onboarding, success and support into three functions that each run well on their own and hand off cleanly to each other. You own how many customers go live, how fast they get there, whether they stay, and how well we support them along the way.

ashby:nox-metals:601b9b37-14d5-43c4-b6c7.summary:
About Nox Metals. American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company in Ferndale, Michigan supplying aluminum plate, bar, and rounds to aerospace and defense manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to American factories faster than the industry thought possible.

The role. We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to own everything that happens after the sale. Every order tracked, every issue closed, every customer kept, every account grown. What happens after the PO is what turns a one-time buyer into a partner for life.

sections.title: Customer Success Manager | Nox Metals | Ferndale, MI
paras: You'll be the customer's first call when something is good, bad, urgent, or confusing. You'll catch problems before they reach a customer's dock, carry real retention and expansion numbers, and bring what customers tell you back to our product, engineering, and operations teams.
If you've spent a few years in customer success or account management and you want to own the whole relationship, this is your next step.

sections.title: You will:
paras: · Own the customer experience end to end after the sale: orders, shipments, issues, renewals
· Own retention and expansion across your accounts and carry real numbers you're expected to hit
· Track every active order across every account: status, dock dates, exceptions, customer expectations

sections.title: You are:
paras: · 3 to 5+ years in customer success, account management, or post-sale roles, ideally in metals, manufacturing, logistics, or B2B SaaS
· A proven owner of retention and expansion with a track record of hitting KPIs
· Skilled at building relationships across buyers, ops leaders, and engineering contacts

sections.title: Nice to have:
paras: · Metals, machine shop, aerospace, or defense account experience

ashby:onebrief:3b87e23c-e07d-4ace-b65f-8.summary:
Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

sections.title: About Onebrief
paras: Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

sections.title: Why This Role Exists
paras: As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

You’ll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. You’ll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.
Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.
Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.
Turn field experience into patterns . Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

sections.title: Minimum Qualifications
bullets: Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams
Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)
Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)
Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments
Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

ashby:owner:6733e842-b846-4a31-bc9f-4d3b.summary:
About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

sections.title: Our vision
paras: We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.
Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

sections.title: Our traction
paras: Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.
More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

sections.title: Our team
paras: Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.
We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

sections.title: Where we work
paras: Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Why we're looking for you
Owner helps restaurants run and grow their businesses online. Our product is moving quickly, and the opportunity is not simply to announce more features. It is to make every important product investment easier to sell, easier to adopt, and more valuable to the restaurants that use it.

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can connect product velocity to commercial impact. You will help our frontline teams win the right customers, retain the customers we have, and clearly explain why Owner is the better choice. You will turn customer and market insight into positioning, proof, enablement, adoption programs, and feedback that shapes what we build next.
bullets: Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Support to understand what helps them close, onboard, adopt, retain, and expand customers.
Identify adoption blockers and churn risks, then turn product capabilities into practical retention and expansion plays.
Create scalable enablement systems and workflows that keep the frontline current without relying on one more training session.
Bring win/loss insight, customer feedback, competitive context, and adoption signals into Product and Marketing planning.
Define the audiences and customer behaviors that matter most for priority capabilities, then build GTM programs that move those behaviors.
Partner with Product early to clarify the customer problem, sharpen the value proposition, and make the eventual GTM motion stronger before development is complete.
Use launches, customer communications, in-product moments, and other channels selectively when they drive a measurable customer or commercial outcome.
Use AI to increase the speed and quality of research, content creation, analysis, and enablement while maintaining a high bar for accuracy.

ashby:perchwell:a0ea5584-8dde-4dc3-8cb1-.summary: Perchwell is the modern real estate listings platform built for agents to search smarter, collaborate better, and close deals faster. We are building the future of residential real estateʼs critical listings infrastructure: a platform where market research and client collaboration converge. Our modern architecture enables continuous innovation at a pace legacy systems cannot match, with AI-powered features and mobile-first capabilities designed for how agents actually work. As consumer expectations and technology evolve, Perchwell remains focused on our core vision: empowering real estate professionals with the most intelligent, data-driven, and connected platform in the industry.

sections.title: Who We Are
paras: Backed by leading venture capital firms including Lux Capital and Founders Fund, along with strategic partnerships with some of the country's top Multiple Listing Services (MLSs), Perchwell represents the first major new platform to enter the listings technology market in decades. This unique combination of institutional investment and deep industry alignment provides both the resources and market validation needed to transform the multi-trillion dollar residential real estate industry.

sections.title: The role
paras: We are hiring a Product Marketing Manager to bring Perchwell's product to market (GTM). You will influence the positioning and messaging for our product, specializing in the product and customer launches that put each release in front of Executive leadership, staff, and real estate agents, and the communication programs that move thousands of real estate agents onto the Perchwell platform. You will execute product and customer launches, run the launch calendar, and build the systems that let a small team ship at the pace the product does.

Perchwell releases to every customer at once and ships continuously, so product launches are a steady stream rather than a few big moments a year. Each release needs messaging that is accurate for the people who run Multiple Listings Services (MLS) and useful to the agents who use our product, along with the assets that drive adoption. The launch process has to be systematic for this to work, and you will grow into owning it end to end, from the roadmap conversation with Product through go-live and the post-launch read on adoption.

Customer launches are the second half of the job. When an MLS moves its membership onto Perchwell, the transition runs over several months. You would build each communication plan with the MLS and our Customer Success team, write what goes out, and carry what you learn into the next one.

sections.title: Product launches and communication
bullets: Run the launch cadence for each release: the brief, the asset checklist, the timeline, and go-live, with Product and Customer Success inputs tracked and chased.
Write the positioning and messaging for each product area, from Search and Add/Edit to Client Collaboration, Reports and Analytics, Admin, and Mobile, and keep the messaging source of truth current.

Produce the launch assets: release messaging, help center articles and updates, Intercom macros for the support team, MLS staff enablement briefs, member emails, What's New entries, and in-app messages.
Turn a technical capability into what an agent, an MLS admin, or an MLS CEO can now do, in their words.
Keep product pages, one-pagers, and demo-deck sections current as the product moves.

sections.title: Customer launches
bullets: Own the member-facing communication plan for each MLS conversion, from announcement through the parallel period, training cohorts, cutover, and the first months after.
Develop campaigns that drive adoption: announcement and reminder emails, newsletter sections, training invitations, town hall materials, FAQ and support Q&A docs, and creative campaigns.
Work directly with the MLS's leadership and staff, and with Perchwell's Customer Success and implementation team, to execute launches as a team.
Track adoption through launches and feed what you learn into the next launch.
Partner with Customer Success to capture testimonials and case studies to enable the Sales team and marketing materials.

ashby:plaid:5b5ff8c1-f0c2-41b6-958a-dad6.summary: We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: GTM Strategy and Execution: Create and drive GTM strategy and launch plans for Credit products. Set goals for GTM programs and track adoption and funnel metrics. Develop integrated campaign strategies with channel owners across marketing. Proactively identify and resolve obstacles to GTM execution.

sections.title: Qualifications
paras: Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!
Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here .

Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Plaid provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location. Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefit plans.
bullets: 8+ years of experience with 5+ years in product marketing or other strategic GTM role at a B2B software company. Credit/Lending experience strongly preferred.
Outstanding written, storytelling and visual communication skills – comfortable developing marketing and sales content that resonates with lenders.
Exceptional ability to conceptualize and execute integrated marketing campaigns

Desire to engage deeply with cross-functional partners across Revenue, Marketing, Product, Design, Engineering – and build an in-depth understanding of how our solutions work and deliver customers value.
Strong presence and verbal communicator

ashby:quantcast:1db26cca-cd51-47c7-a2e8-.summary: At Quantcast, we don't just build advertising technology, we revolutionize how it works. Our AI-powered Demand Side Platform (DSP) connects the world's most ambitious marketers with their ideal audiences across the open internet, delivering results that actually move the needle. Since 2006, we've been the industry's trailblazer, launching the first AI-powered measurement platform for publishers and the first AI-driven DSP. Our AI doesn't just optimize—it delivers the measurable outcomes that matter most to our clients, giving them the competitive edge they need in a crowded marketplace. Ready to join the team that's defining the future of digital advertising?

sections.title: What you'll do:
bullets: Set goals and provide feedback on performance of team members helping clients’ address their business challenges with recommendations backed up with proven data/insight/results.

Leads and mentors high performing Account Managers through acquisition of product knowledge, consultative up-selling skills, client messaging, strategic conversation and negotiation skills, and navigation tactics to address customer objectives and problems.
Develop and execute account strategy that will maximize the amount of advertiser spend with Quantcast’s managed service and platform offerings.
Serve as a liaison to clients regarding new product launches and advertising opportunities while ensuring that clients are satisfied with their business growth.
Recruit, evaluate, hire and onboard top account management talent to meet growth expectations.

sections.title: Who you are:
bullets: Education: College Degree.
Experience: 5-8 years experience in advertising/marketing industry with broad context around industry best practices within media and digital advertising.
Manager of a local team with different levels of maturity and experience of Corporate or Field Sales Account Managers.

Solid understanding of the digital landscape, principles of marketing, advertising and media strategy (both brand and direct response), as well as media concepts and terms, creative and budget requirements.
Awareness and ability to uncover client business issues, discuss industry trends, consumer trends and how these can be translated to develop effective advertiser strategy.
Must possess strong written, presentation, analytical, quantitative, verbal skills. Superior organizational, interpersonal, and managerial skills.

ashby:ramp:df5e48f0-f7a0-4cf3-a85b-9d4bb.summary:
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Ramp is hiring a Manager, CSM, New Products to build and lead the team that helps customers put our newest products to work. This team supports customers across segments. Its job is to take a new product from sales handoff through implementation, first useful result, and early adoption, then make sure the next owner has a clear path forward.

The products and customer needs will change. You will build a team and an operating rhythm that can change with them. You will coach people with different strengths, help them make good decisions when the playbook is still being written, and turn what we learn from customers into a better way to launch the next one. You will work closely with Sales, core Customer Success, Solutions, Product, and Operations to make the customer experience feel coordinated.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Hire, onboard, coach, and develop a growing team of Customer Activation Managers. Set a clear bar for customer judgment, implementation ownership, follow-through, and communication.

Give direct, useful feedback through customer-call reviews, case discussions, one-on-ones, and development plans. Help strong individual contributors grow into broader scope and address performance gaps early.

Help the team turn an unclear sales handoff into a customer plan with the right stakeholders, prerequisites, owners, milestones, and first useful outcome. Step in on complex launches and escalations when your judgment will move the work forward.

Build and improve the team's implementation process: assignment and handoff, customer discovery, launch plans, specialist engagement, first-use checks, adoption follow-up, and the transition to ongoing ownership.

Make ownership clear when a customer has both a core Customer Success Manager and a New Products specialist. Keep one customer plan while giving the specialist room to lead the product implementation.

Use customer progress, launch quality, team capacity, and time spent on implementations to spot where customers or team members are getting stuck. Adjust coverage and process based on what the data and customer work show.
Partner with Sales, Product, Solutions, Support, and Customer Success leaders to resolve recurring blockers, set realistic customer expectations, and improve product readiness and the next launch.
Bring early customer patterns back to Product and leadership. Be specific about what customers can do today, what takes specialist help, and what we need to change before the motion scales.

sections.title: What You'll Need
bullets: Either 2+ years directly managing a customer success, implementation, solutions, or consulting team or 6+ years as an individual contributor in one or more of those roles, with clear evidence that you have coached others and led work beyond your own accounts.

A record of taking customers through a complex implementation or workflow change, from discovery and planning to first use and adoption. You know how to tell whether a customer is actually using what was launched.
Experience building or improving a process that other people used, with examples of what you changed after seeing it work in practice.
Strong coaching judgment. You can diagnose whether someone needs clearer expectations, better skills, more support, or a change in approach, and you can give feedback that improves performance.

Comfort making coverage and prioritization decisions with incomplete information. You can balance customer complexity, team capacity, and product readiness without losing sight of the customer's outcome.
The ability to work across Sales, Product, Solutions, and Customer Success when ownership is shared or a customer issue has no obvious answer.
Clear communication with customers, individual contributors, and senior leaders. You can explain a risk, make a recommendation, and identify the next owner and step.

Curiosity about new products and enough technical and finance fluency to ask good questions, challenge a launch plan, and bring in the right expert. You do not need to be the specialist for every product the team supports.

ashby:rescale:f520b63c-fc7d-4667-85bb-bd.summary: Rescale is pioneering the future of engineering and scientific discovery. As the leader in digital engineering, we’re transforming how products are developed—through intelligent automation, applied AI, data management, and the integration of the world’s largest network of engineering and R&D applications. Joining Rescale means becoming part of a diverse, collaborative, and mission-driven team that’s unlocking faster innovation across industries like aerospace, energy, life sciences, and manufacturing. We’re solving complex challenges that traditional HPC can’t—and we’re seeking passionate, curious minds to help build the next wave of breakthroughs.

sections.title: You Will Work On and Impact:
bullets: Becoming a trusted technical advisor and owning the technical relationship with customers.
Lead technical activities from deployment, to lunch and learn, to user training and support.
Collaborate with Rescale Solutions Architect to plan and execute a successful deployment of Rescale solutions.
Work independently to analyze technical needs, requirements, the customer's current infrastructure, operations, and workflows.
Onboard new customer workflows and grow Rescale footprint.
Gain deep knowledge of customer workflows and HPC environments.
Work with customers to define and execute customers’ digital transformation strategy to continue to migrate workloads from on-prem to the cloud.
Articulate and present Rescale solutions at conferences, user groups, webinars, etc.

sections.title: Key Qualifications
bullets: Customer obsession is your top priority.
You use empathy to approach customer solutions.
You enjoy solving difficult problems and strive to find the best solutions.
You have at least 2 years of software, hardware, or cloud experience in a customer facing role
B.S. in engineering, computer science, math, physics or equivalent.
Candidate must be a U.S. Person

sections.title: Preferred Qualifications
bullets: 3 years of enterprise cloud, hardware, or software technical experience.

General knowledge in at least one of the high performance computing (HPC) disciplines (such as CFD, FEA, Molecular Dynamics, Weather Forecasting, Computational Chemistry, Reservoir (Seismic) Simulation, Media Rendering, Machine Learning, Financial etc)
Experience with enterprise customers in one or more of the industry verticals we serve including aerospace, automotive, life sciences, oil & gas, semiconductor, EDA, federal sector.

Experience with at least one of HPC simulation software (such as packages from ANSYS, Siemens, Dassault Systèmes, COMSOL, AVL, Altair, PTC, Cadence, Synopsys, Autodesk, OpenFOAM, LAMMPS. GROMACS, NAMD, etc)
Strong presenter and are able to present highly technical topics in an easy-to-understand manner.
M.S. in engineering, computer science, or equivalent preferred.
Ability to manage multiple projects which are complex in nature and coordinate colleagues across diverse teams and locations.
Demonstrate understanding of HPC, scheduler, IaaS, scripting languages and how these tools are used and deployed by customers.

ashby:resq:fe93b25a-8f87-4828-b371-f9b22.summary:
ResQ is reinventing how commercial repair and maintenance works 🛠️. We take care of everything that breaks inside a commercial location, from HVAC and refrigeration to plumbing, electrical and kitchen equipment, for restaurants and facilities teams across North America. Our promise is simple: one company owns the outcome, and it’s us.

In the traditional trades model, every breakdown and repeat visit is another invoice. We flipped that. ResQ is the only trades company that prices around results, so we succeed when equipment stays running and problems get fixed the first time. Every job is backed by flat-rate pricing, a free second visit if a repair isn’t fixed, and the longest labor warranty in the category.

That model works because of the technology behind it. Our AI-powered platform builds a living record of every customer’s equipment, including its history, warranties and what’s…

sections.title: What you will do:
paras: As an Account Manager at ResQ, you'll own and grow a portfolio of existing restaurant customers. You'll be responsible for strengthening relationships, driving customer retention, and uncovering new opportunities to expand our services across their businesses.
This is not just a customer relationship management role — you'll have a strong sales focus, with accountability for generating revenue through account expansion, cross-selling, and upselling.
bullets: Account Management & Relationships 🧡: Own a portfolio of restaurant customers, build strong relationships with key decision-makers, and become their trusted partner for repairs, maintenance, and facilities services.

Account Growth & Sales 📈: Proactively identify and close opportunities to upsell and cross-sell additional services, expand into new customer locations, and increase revenue within your existing accounts.
Customer Retention 🤝: Monitor account health, understand customer challenges, and take a proactive approach to improving satisfaction, strengthening relationships, and reducing churn.
Strategic Account Planning 🎯: Develop account growth plans, identify opportunities within multi-location restaurant groups, and conduct regular business reviews to drive long-term partnerships.
Customer Experience 🛠️: Collaborate with internal operations and service teams to ensure customers receive exceptional service and issues are resolved efficiently.
Performance & Reporting 📊: Own your account growth targets, maintain an accurate sales pipeline, and track key metrics including revenue expansion, retention, and customer engagement.
Cross-Functional Collaboration 👥: Work closely with Sales, Operations, Partner Operations, and other internal teams to deliver a seamless customer experience and unlock new business opportunities.

sections.title: Who you are:
bullets: 4–5+ years of experience in account management or sales, ideally within restaurant services, facilities management, or commercial maintenance.
Proven track record of growing accounts, exceeding sales targets, and driving revenue through upselling, cross-selling, and expansion.
Experience selling services into the restaurant, hospitality, or commercial services industries is a strong asset.
Excellent relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to engage key decision-makers.
A proactive, sales-driven mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and close deals.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities.
Experience using CRM tools to manage accounts and track sales opportunities.
A customer-first, results-driven self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

sections.title: How you will do it:
bullets: Be a self-starter: You wake up, form a plan, and get going! You're proactive in identifying opportunities and driving results.
Practice Extreme Ownership: Take initiative, demonstrate a bias for action, understand our customers and their businesses, and persevere through challenges until you succeed.
Break Through Walls to Win: Find creative solutions, overcome obstacles, and consistently look for ways to grow our customer relationships and business.
Be open to feedback: Listen, learn, and iterate. We're all One Team!
Deliver WOW Experiences: Live and breathe a customer-first mindset, building trust and setting new standards for exceptional service.

sections.title: Want to learn more? 👀 Keep Reading!
paras: We are a mission-driven team and have a big vision to revolutionize the service industry. While on that journey, we recognize that building a startup is very hard. Turning vision into reality in a fast-growing environment takes superhuman efforts and is often one of the most difficult, yet rewarding, things one can do.

We do our best to ensure transparency during all stages of the interview process but we realize it's a lot of information 📚 to take in at once so we wanted to centralize everything to make it easier for you to navigate through. We have created a Talent Notion page which will help you learn more about us during the recruitment process.

ashby:revin:ebb5a5ef-115a-43fb-afac-7c97.summary:
Revin · Customer Success · Flatiron, New York City

Base: $130,000-150,000; Variable Comp: $20,000; OTE $150,000-170,000 + meaningful early equity · Full-time

Four days per week in our Flatiron office, with one remote day and flexibility when life comes up.

sections.title: About Revin
paras: Revin builds AI-powered software for the businesses that keep our homes running: roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, and more. We help these businesses respond to customers, book appointments, and manage the customer experience across voice, SMS, and email.

Revin handles around half a million customer conversations a month. Businesses with hundreds of millions in annual revenue rely on our products for work that directly affects their customers and their bottom line.
Our customers include Vertex Service Partners, a national roofing and exterior-services platform with over $600M in revenue, and Del-Air, a $300M+ HVAC and plumbing business.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We are hiring a Customer Success Manager to partner across Revin’s account base. This is a high-touch role centered on structured onboarding and implementation, ongoing relationship management, and account expansion.

You will work with multi-location home services businesses, including family-owned operators and private equity-backed rollups. In most cases, the customer purchasing Revin has a substantial footprint across brands, call centers, geographies, and systems. Your responsibility is to guide those customers through a rigorous adoption process, shape implementation plans that reflect their operational realities, and ensure they realize measurable value on a defined timeline.

As the person responsible for customer outcomes, you also will work closely with a pod of Forward Deployed Engineers who are responsible for building and customizing agents for their customers. While they are in the weeds building, your job is to drive high-level customer strategy and make sure FDEs are doing the right thing at the right time to maximize customer outcomes.

sections.title: What You Will Do
bullets: Own the end-to-end relationship with customers as they implement and expand Revin across locations, brands, and teams.
Lead structured onboarding and implementation planning, coordinating contract milestones, rollout waves, operational priorities, and cross-functional dependencies.
Run a call-heavy cadence with customers, driving product understanding, sharing best practices, and moving deployments forward against defined milestones.
Closely track account health KPIs for your customers, surface issues and opportunities and be proactive about working with internal or customer teams to address them.

Manage a pod of three Forward Deployed Engineers to ensure they are prioritizing customer agent builds appropriately, managing the relationship with their customer counterparts, and meeting timelines promised to clients.

Guide customers through the adoption of Revin across voice, SMS, and email channels, with a strong focus on operational quality, compliance, and customer trust. Proactively monitor and address expansion opportunities.
Travel to customer sites approximately 1-2 times per month for day trips or short overnight visits.
Support a customer portfolio that ranges from sophisticated enterprise organizations to operators adopting modern AI tooling for the first time.

sections.title: What to Expect in the Role
bullets: The role is highly cross-functional and requires comfort operating with both customer stakeholders and internal product and technical teams. In addition to traditional CS responsibilities you will be deeply involved with managing the FDE motion and facilitating feedback loops with product and engineering.
This is a call-heavy role. Expect approximately 40% of your time to be spent on customer calls, running strategic discussions or leading discovery.
You will work across home services categories such as roofing, HVAC, and adjacent trades. Prior home services experience is not required.
You will operate in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve quickly and internal processes are actively being codified. The CS function is new at Revin and you will help build and scale it.

ashby:sandboxaq:35fd6553-0dde-4e68-a757-.summary:
SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a…

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: SandboxAQ’s AI Simulation (AISim) division develops and applies Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) that are grounded in physics, chemistry, mathematics and biology to simulate molecular behavior with scientific precision and accelerate discovery in the physical world across biopharma, chemicals, advanced materials, healthcare, and so much more.

The AISim division is seeking an exceptional Vice President or Senior Director of Product Management to own the strategy, roadmap, and commercial trajectory of the ChemSim business — SandboxAQ's AI-driven materials discovery platform. This is a dual-mandate leadership role: in the near term, this leader will be the primary product driver for SandboxAQ's $500M CHIPS Act R&D award from the U.S. Department of Commerce, ensuring the team delivers against the program's contractual milestone gates across four critical-material verticals — Catalysis, Batteries, Magnets, and PFAS Replacements. In parallel, this leader will build the commercial foundation that transforms ChemSim from a government-funded R&D program into a product-led growth business generating durable, recurring revenue from the broader materials discovery market.

Reporting to the Vice President of Product, this leader will manage a team of 4 PM ICs — one per contracted vertical — while partnering closely with the Senior Director of Platform PM in a two-in-a-box model. Beyond the CHIPS mandate, they will own the ChemSim go-to-market strategy, pricing and packaging, and expansion into adjacent verticals including oil and gas, energy, specialty chemicals, and advanced manufacturing. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity to shape a category-defining AI platform for materials science at the intersection of national security, scientific discovery, and commercial scale.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
bullets: Customer centric product requirements and development: understand customer lifecycles, top use cases, problems statements, continuous customer feedback

Own the ChemSim product strategy: define the product go-to-market approach, pricing and packaging model, channel selection, and customer segmentation for semiconductor ecosystem customers and expansion verticals (oil and gas, energy, specialty chemicals, advanced manufacturing).
Build and execute on a multi-year product roadmap and own ChemSim product launches end to end
Hire, develop, and lead a team of 3-4 PM ICs across the Catalysis, Batteries, PFAS, and Magnets verticals — driving key deliverables personally until the team is fully ramped.

Partner with the Senior Director of PM, Core Platform in a two-in-a-box model to define, prioritize, and sequence the platform capabilities required to support ChemSim's contractual and commercial milestones.
Serve as the primary product voice to DOC/CRDO program stakeholders, semiconductor ecosystem partners, and prospective commercial customers for ChemSim.

sections.title: Essential Skills & Experience
bullets: 10+ years in product management, including 5+ years managing teams of individual contributors.
Track record shipping AI/ML-driven platform products at enterprise scale, including experience with multi-tenant SaaS, API governance, and enterprise security and compliance.
Comfort navigating deep ambiguity: translating unclear scientific and customer problems into structured roadmaps, success criteria, and measurable outcomes.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

sections.title: Preferred Desired Skills & Experience
bullets: Familiarity with ChemSim's customers: semiconductor manufacturing, oil and gas, energy storage, specialty chemicals, or advanced manufacturing.

Strong domain expertise in materials science, chemistry, chemical engineering, or an adjacent scientific discipline — sufficient to engage credibly with computational scientists, experimental validation partners, and domain SMEs.

Track record building product-led growth motions for technical or scientific software platforms, including community-driven adoption, developer/scientist self-serve, and land-and-expand commercial models.
Physically located in the Greater Seattle Metropolitan area or SF Bay Area
Experience working on U.S. government R&D programs — CHIPS Act, DARPA, DOE, or equivalent — including familiarity with milestone-gated funding structures and Fulfillment/compliance processes.
MBA, or equivalent business leadership and P&L experience.

ashby:searchable:df13413c-5807-4f1e-9c68.summary:
Searchable is an agentic marketing platform built for the age of AI search. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews have transformed how people discover information. Brands now need to measure and optimise their visibility across all of the major AI search engines.

We help companies grow their organic presence across SEO, AEO, and GEO through a fully agentic platform that identifies opportunities, recommends actions, and automates improvements with Searchable’s AI agent. We’re at $5M ARR in just 10 months, backed by top angels and VCs, and building the team that will define the category.

We are office-based 4 days a week in Salt Lake City. If you thrive in a startup culture where people put in hours because they love solving hard problems and taking radical ownership, you'll fit right in.

sections.title: The Role
paras: You’ll be one of the first Customer Success Managers on Searchable’s U.S. team, reporting to the Head of Customer Success. You’ll own a book of mid-market brands and agencies from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

This isn’t a support seat or a relationship-only role. You’ll manage a larger book with faster cycles, so you’ll need to know where to spend your time, help customers turn AI Search data into decisions quickly, and build the scalable playbooks, reporting and programs that let the team grow without adding headcount at the same rate.
You don’t need to know our platform on day one. We’ll teach the product. We’re hiring for ownership, judgment and the ability to build.

sections.title: What you’ll do
bullets: Own a book of mid-market brands and agencies end to end: onboarding, adoption, renewal and expansion.
Get new customers to a first meaningful result fast, with prompt sets, competitor tracking and a clear visibility baseline in place within their first weeks.
Run focused, efficient business reviews that connect AI Search visibility, sentiment and AI referral traffic to the customer’s goals, scaled to the size and potential of each account.
Prioritise your book using usage and health data, spot risk early and act on it before it shows up at renewal.
Own a high volume of renewals and drive expansion: more prompt volume and capacity, brands, markets and agency clients.
Build relationships beyond a single champion, up to Director and Head of Marketing level, often in lean teams where one person wears many hats.
Design and run one-to-many motions, such as onboarding webinars, templated reviews, office hours and automated check-ins, so every customer gets value, not just the largest.
Turn one-off fixes into playbooks, templates and reporting the whole team uses.

sections.title: Who you are
paras: Just as important, you care about your customers’ success and hold a clear bar for quality in your own work, even at volume. You get fluent in the platform fast and use its data to tell customers something they didn’t know.
bullets: Owner mindset. You treat your accounts like your own business. You look at the data and come to customers with a recommendation, not a status update, and you raise risk before anyone asks.
Ruthless prioritiser. You can manage a large book without letting anything slip. You know which accounts need a call, which need an email and which need nothing this week.
Self-directed builder. You don’t wait for a playbook to exist. When you solve a problem for one customer, you build the thing that solves it for the next fifty.

Commercially sharp. You spot revenue opportunities in your book and go after them. You grow accounts by growing the customer’s results, so expansion feels like the obvious next step, not a sales pitch.

sections.title: What we’re looking for
bullets: 3-4 years in Customer Success, account management or client services at a B2B SaaS company or agency.
Experience managing a large book of SMB or mid-market accounts, with a track record of owning renewals and driving expansion against a number.
Clear, concise writing, from a two-line recap to a scalable email sequence or account plan.
Comfort with data: you can pull the story out of a dashboard, explain it simply and use it to prioritise your time.

ashby:sewer-ai:9041fb62-07b4-48a5-bfa5-c.summary: SewerAI is transforming underground infrastructure management through AI-powered inspection and risk analysis. Our platform helps contractors, engineering firms, and utilities unlock valuable insights from sewer inspection data—turning hours of manual video review into actionable intelligence in minutes. After doubling our customer base over the past year, we’re now entering an exciting phase of accelerated growth.

sections.title: Summary
paras: Almost every major municipal program we've won had an engineering firm in the room. The firm was the route in, the credibility, or the delivery capacity, and often all three. Eight of those firms have signed on as SewerAI partners, with offices in 49 states. When they refer us to a utility, we win far more often than when we go in cold. The problem is volume: referrals arrive one partner at a time, when they arrive at all.

The Senior Partner Manager fixes that. You own every engineering-firm partner relationship and the partner-sourced bookings number, pair our AEs with the partners in their territory, and run the program that rewards firms for referrals. The measure is partner-sourced pipeline and bookings, not logos on a partner page.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Own the partner-sourced pipeline and bookings number for SewerAI's engineering-firm partners: referrals in, deals closed, fees paid.

Run the relationships with 8–10 partner firms, from the national firms to the regional specialists: regular check-ins with each firm's partner lead, quarterly business reviews, and agreement renewals and negotiations.

Build the referral machine. Pair every SewerAI Account Executive with home partners in their territory, run monthly pipeline syncs and quarterly territory plans with each firm, and make sure every referral is registered, worked and followed up.
Run the partner program: points, partner levels, quarterly statements to each firm, and referral-fee payouts with Finance. Move existing partners onto one standard agreement as they renew.

Train partner teams (project managers, client service leads, business developers) on Pioneer, AutoCode and Risk & Rehab, and coordinate their SewerAI certification. Train our AEs on how to work with engineering counterparts.
Drive joint marketing with Marketing: co-branded case studies, joint webinars, launches to partners' internal offices, and co-presented sessions at WEFTEC, NASSCO and state water conferences.
Keep attribution clean. Every partner-sourced opportunity carries the partner in Salesforce, every referral is registered, and leadership can see the channel's pipeline at any time.
Hold the line on the rules: no exclusivity or territory promises outside the program, and Risk & Rehab is never positioned as an engineering deliverable. We code and score; the partner engineers.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: 6+ years in partner or channel management, alliances, or B2B sales, including 3+ years managing partners who source revenue through referral, co-sell or resale.
A track record of building a partner-sourced pipeline number from a small base, with the numbers to show it.
Experience working with or inside consulting engineering (AEC) firms. You know how a firm wins a CIP program, how its PMs and business developers are measured, and why billable hours matter to them.
Comfort with municipal and utility buying: RFPs and RFQs, co-op contracts, council approvals and capital-plan cycles.
An operator's habits: you live in Salesforce, keep a clean ledger, and build the scorecard yourself.
Equally at home presenting alongside a partner principal at WEFTEC and sitting with an AE on a pipeline review the same afternoon.
Civil or environmental engineering background, or experience in wastewater collection systems (preferred).
Familiarity with PACP/NASSCO, CCTV inspection or rehab planning (preferred).

sections.title: What success looks like in year one
bullets: Every partner has named SewerAI AE counterparts, a territory plan and a monthly pipeline rhythm.
Partner referrals arrive as a steady monthly flow from several firms, not one partner at a time.
Partner-sourced bookings are a line the business plans on, with clean attribution behind every dollar.

ashby:sierra:9b94e279-5869-4a33-b50f-9aa.summary:

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Build enterprise-grade AI agents : As an Agent PM at Sierra, you will be responsible for partnering directly with our engineers and customers to build and ship AI agents that handle thousands of customer conversations a day.

Prepare and present demonstrations of Sierra’s agent.
Address and overcome technical challenges in the business process by working with technical counterparts.
Develop and improve Sierra virtual agents to fit and anticipate our customers’ needs and business processes.

Experience crafting and tailoring a message for potential customers, including executives.
Ability to communicate highly technical concepts to both non-technical and technically proficient audiences, including recent AI developments.
Professional fluency in both Spanish and English.
Degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent professional experience.

sections.title: Even better...
bullets: AI-related experience (experience with product development for AI agents a plus).

sections.title: Be you, with us
paras: We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world.
